name: Four Seasons Hotel Shenzhen
insider_take: This soaring luxury tower puts you at the heart of China's Silicon Valley, where ancient traditions blend with cutting-edge innovation just steps from Hong Kong.
whats_special: Occupying floors 95-98 of the iconic Ping An Finance Centre (the world's 4th tallest building), this sky-high sanctuary offers breathtaking views of the Pearl River Delta. The hotel features the highest Four Seasons spa globally and houses Shenzhen's most elevated dining venues, including a Michelin-starred restaurant with panoramic city vistas.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the Cloud 9 Spa during sunset hours – you'll literally be above the clouds while watching the city transform from day to night across the sprawling metropolis below.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature afternoon tea service on the 95th floor, offering views stretching to Hong Kong on clear days. Also experience the rooftop infinity pool that makes you feel like you're swimming in the sky, and explore nearby Futian District's tech headquarters where companies like Tencent and Huawei have transformed this former fishing village into a global innovation hub.
pros: Prime location in Futian CBD with excellent connectivity
Signature Four Seasons luxury service and amenities
Spacious rooms and suites with modern design
Multiple dining options and rooftop facilities
